Hey Samir — thanks for signing up and for the note on the form. Quick intro: I’m Ben on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. We want to make the demo useful, so a few short questions before we lock time: 

1) Primary use case: search relevance vs. chat/assist vs. summarization? (one-line ok)
2) Expected volume: monthly requests and peak tokens per minute / qps during promotions
3) Timeline: pilot dates and target GA (months)
4) Any compliance constraints (VPC, data residency, SOC2 evidence) or SSO requirements?

I’ve got availability Tue/Wed 9–12 PT and Thu 1–4 PT. If none of those work, send a couple of slots and I’ll coordinate. I’m attaching a short self-serve checklist (stub) so you can see what information helps us scope the pilot.

Attachment: selfserve-onboarding-checklist.pdf (1 page stub)

Looking forward — Ben

ben@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Subject: Re: Aligning fastmart use-case, traffic buckets, and demo time

Hi Ben — thanks for reaching out. Quick answers below: 

1) Use case: improving on-site search relevance and checkout suggestions (primary), with a secondary interest in short-form product summarization for listings.
2) Volume: ~1.2M queries/month today. Peak events (promos) spike to ~250 qps for short bursts; baseline qps ~15. Typical request payload 150–400 tokens.
3) Timeline: looking to run a 6‑8 week pilot starting late Oct, aim to evaluate for a holiday ramp in Nov/Dec.
4) Compliance: SOC2 is required; SSO (Okta) would be great for the team later. No on-prem need initially.

For timing, Thu 9/21 at 10:30 PT works for me. Can you send a calendar invite?

—Samir
Samir Patel | Head of ML Platforms, FastMart
samir@fastmart.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
